task.question: Who is acclaimed as leader of the Quebec Liberal Party in February 2026?

Who is acclaimed as leader of the Quebec Liberal Party in February 2026?

[2026 Quebec Liberal Party leadership election] In 2026, the Quebec Liberal Party announced a leadership election to choose a permanent successor to Pablo Rodriguez. Rodriguez announced his resignation on December 17, 2025, amid a political crisis and scandal. Businessman and pharmacist Charles Milliard was acclaimed as party leader on February 13 as no other candidates qualified on the ballot. | other articles: Quebec Liberal Party, 2026 Quebec general election
